title: What the knots read when nothing crosses yet
objective: PICK-TWO-20261118-001's first direction, chosen by the coordinator: SEED's switch, one free fill while no two splits cross, is where the two enters. What state of the knots does that condition read? Proposed: with knot-local moves, no two splits cross exactly while the knots close no cycle (the knot complex's second Betti number is zero). Proof of the switch reading; frozen runs of KF3, NN, NN2 and SEEDK (SEED with knot-local moves and its switch read from the knots) from every bracketing of 5 to 8, checking the reading at every step and reading SEEDK's tiers; other knot readings tested against it. Serves G1 and G16; challenges A101.
stop_rule: One proof and one frozen computation with its read-out; referee hand-off; report.
